fields.statement: At ac061b1b, built go build -trimpath -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza and used it by hand in a scratch git repo (RHIZA_* unset, fake rex on PATH, built-in plan workflow). run start --workflow plan --new 'Plan the milestone' --milestone --autonomous exited 2 with '--autonomous is refused on a plan run that plans a milestone: milestone planning needs the owner, even in autonomous mode', with and without --foreground and with --dry-run --json (code usage); run start <record change set> --workflow plan --autonomous, queued or --foreground, and api call run.start with autonomous:true on it, each exited 2 the same way; the change set count stayed 2 and no .git/rhiza/runs was written. Without --autonomous both milestone starts dry-run fine (exit 0), and --new 'Plan an intention' --autonomous dry-runs with autonomous true. With a no-agent plan.toml, a real run on the record change set succeeded; after editing its journal's started entry to autonomous:true, run resume and run resume --retry each exited 2 with the same error (before the edit resume said it was finished, exit 3). Gap: run start --new 'Ship v3' --request <a milestone-kind request> --autonomous without --milestone dry-runs with autonomous true on an intention change set (with --milestone it is refused): the request's kind is not checked, reported as a finding.

At ac061b1b, with the built binary in a scratch repo (RHIZA_* unset, RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG so nothing is spawned): queued a milestone request 'Ship v3', a feature 'Add search' and a bug 'Crash on save', ran rhiza daemon set rhiza.autonomy.plan auto and rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --max-runs 4 --once. It started three plan runs; the detach log shows 'run start --foreground --workflow plan --new Ship v3 --request <id> --permission-mode manual --milestone' with no --autonomous, and '--new Add search ... --autonomous' and '--new Fix Crash on save ... --autonomous'. request ls shows all three planning.
